text: The two kept dancing, so relentlessly that the reflection could not feel her toes. She asked for a little rest, but the red dragon was never satisfied.

content: Here, Loughshinny.

raw: The book you wanted. The sequel to the Steam Knights adventures.
content: The book you wanted. The sequel to the Steam Knights adventures.
'Why', you ask?

raw: Do I need a reason to do something for my beloved sister?
content: Do I need a reason to do something for my beloved sister?

raw: But, do you really need to read it?
content: But, do you really need to read it?

raw: Do you really need to read a book you have no interest in at all, but feel pressured by others our age to read?
content: Do you really need to read a book you have no interest in at all, but feel pressured by others our age to read?

speaker: Loughshinny
content: I do want to read it.

raw: [name="Eblana"]Didn't you tell Father you didn't want anyone asking you why a Victorian wouldn't enjoy stories about the Steam Knights?
speaker: Eblana
content: Didn't you tell Father you didn't want anyone asking you why a Victorian wouldn't enjoy stories about the Steam Knights?

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]This book... did Dad ask you to buy it for me?
speaker: Loughshinny
content: This book... did Dad ask you to buy it for me?

speaker: Eblana
content: Why do you ask?

speaker: Loughshinny
content: Because... how did you know?

speaker: Eblana
content: You're backing away from me, Loughshinny.

raw: [name="Eblana"]I don't want you to be scared of me like everyone else.
speaker: Eblana
content: I don't want you to be scared of me like everyone else.

speaker: Loughshinny
content: No, I...

raw: [name="Eblana"]If me knowing what you told Father is so scary, how about we dance together to calm you down? Hm?
speaker: Eblana
content: If me knowing what you told Father is so scary, how about we dance together to calm you down? Hm?

speaker: Loughshinny
content: A... dance? Really?

speaker: Eblana
content: Why not?

raw: With those words, Eblana gracefully extends a hand towards her sister.
content: With those words, Eblana gracefully extends a hand towards her sister.

raw: But in Loughshinny's memories, even when her parents put on their favorite music, even when Father shook his head to the melody, even when Mother tapped her fingers to the beat...
content: But in Loughshinny's memories, even when her parents put on their favorite music, even when Father shook his head to the melody, even when Mother tapped her fingers to the beat...

raw: Her sister would only sit perfectly still while bearing an icy smile.
content: Her sister would only sit perfectly still while bearing an icy smile.

raw: She had never moved her body to any tune. Not even once.
content: She had never moved her body to any tune. Not even once.

raw: [name="Eblana"]Once you can keep up with me, you'll no longer have to worry about any book, request, or even friends our age.
speaker: Eblana
content: Once you can keep up with me, you'll no longer have to worry about any book, request, or even friends our age.

raw: The unopened knight novel falls to the ground, and the pleasant new book smell is now drowned by muddy water.
content: The unopened knight novel falls to the ground, and the pleasant new book smell is now drowned by muddy water.

raw: She was still young then. She never imagined that achieving her desires could feel so heavy and bitter. She only remembers stumbling, turning away, ignoring what was reaching out to her...
content: She was still young then. She never imagined that achieving her desires could feel so heavy and bitter. She only remembers stumbling, turning away, ignoring what was reaching out to her...
A soft and cold hand.

speaker: Eblana
content: Loughshinny.

raw: [name="Eblana"]The crowd is gone. You need no longer hide your identity.
speaker: Eblana
content: The crowd is gone. You need no longer hide your identity.

raw: [name="Eblana"]Do you still think of them as alive, even now?
speaker: Eblana
content: Do you still think of them as alive, even now?

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]I only know that every Taran's heart burns with a similar flame. And that ever since our ancestors first bent the knee to the Victorians, that flame has never gone out.
speaker: Loughshinny
content: I only know that every Taran's heart burns with a similar flame. And that ever since our ancestors first bent the knee to the Victorians, that flame has never gone out.

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]That goes for all the townsfolk, as well as those who followed me back here. They all have the same fire, except that theirs has never been tainted by the shade of death.
speaker: Loughshinny
content: That goes for all the townsfolk, as well as those who followed me back here. They all have the same fire, except that theirs has never been tainted by the shade of death.

speaker: Eblana
content: What a wonderful analogy, Loughshinny.

raw: [name="Eblana"]Then let me ask you again: what will you do?
speaker: Eblana
content: Then let me ask you again: what will you do?

raw: [name="Eblana"]Dye these flames in your own hue? I imagine you must have tried already.
speaker: Eblana
content: Dye these flames in your own hue? I imagine you must have tried already.

raw: [name="Eblana"]No matter who they are, once tainted by death, your flames can only render them into ash.
speaker: Eblana
content: No matter who they are, once tainted by death, your flames can only render them into ash.

raw: [name="Eblana"]So I have a proposal, Loughshinny. Kill me.
speaker: Eblana
content: So I have a proposal, Loughshinny. Kill me.

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]And everyone in the city as well?
speaker: Loughshinny
content: And everyone in the city as well?

raw: [name="Eblana"]If it bothers you how this will be recorded in history, then you can just say that I killed them, and that you merely laid them to rest.
speaker: Eblana
content: If it bothers you how this will be recorded in history, then you can just say that I killed them, and that you merely laid them to rest.

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]The people of Na Saoirsí are still alive.
speaker: Loughshinny
content: The people of Na Saoirsí are still alive.

raw: [name="Eblana"]Even if what animates their bodies is not life, but death?
speaker: Eblana
content: Even if what animates their bodies is not life, but death?

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]If they were truly devoid of even the faintest spark of life, they would have long since become one of those hollow, shambling corpses you have wandering about.
speaker: Loughshinny
content: If they were truly devoid of even the faintest spark of life, they would have long since become one of those hollow, shambling corpses you have wandering about.

speaker: Eblana
content: Oh, they will. Eventually.

speaker: Loughshinny
content: No, they won't.

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]I'd rather see the purple flames in them as a plague, one instigated by you.
speaker: Loughshinny
content: I'd rather see the purple flames in them as a plague, one instigated by you.

raw: [name="Eblana"]And you plan to find a cure for it?
speaker: Eblana
content: And you plan to find a cure for it?

speaker: Loughshinny
content: That's right.

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]I want to cure you of it as well, Eblana.
speaker: Loughshinny
content: I want to cure you of it as well, Eblana.

speaker: Eblana
content: How wonderful.

speaker: Loughshinny
content: ...Wonderful?

speaker: Eblana
content: Yes. That's absolutely wonderful.

speaker: Eblana
content: Did you not notice?

raw: [name="Eblana"]You aren't trying to run from me anymore. You're trying to cure me, of all things.
speaker: Eblana
content: You aren't trying to run from me anymore. You're trying to cure me, of all things.

raw: [name="Eblana"]Come, dance with me, Loughshinny. The same dance I've always invited you to, the one you always ran from.
speaker: Eblana
content: Come, dance with me, Loughshinny. The same dance I've always invited you to, the one you always ran from.

speaker: Loughshinny
content: What... did you say?

raw: [name="Eblana"]I asked you to dance with me.
speaker: Eblana
content: I asked you to dance with me.

raw: [name="Eblana"]But before the final bar, be sure to pierce my heart with your spear. This plague is lethal, and there is no cure. I do not question your resolve, but your efforts will be in vain.
speaker: Eblana
content: But before the final bar, be sure to pierce my heart with your spear. This plague is lethal, and there is no cure. I do not question your resolve, but your efforts will be in vain.

raw: [name="Eblana"]You've run from your fate long enough... From Na Saoirsí's fate, and ours too.
speaker: Eblana
content: You've run from your fate long enough... From Na Saoirsí's fate, and ours too.

raw: [name="Eblana"]It is not yet Samhain, but the boundary between life and death is more ambiguous than it has been in all of Taran history.
speaker: Eblana
content: It is not yet Samhain, but the boundary between life and death is more ambiguous than it has been in all of Taran history.

raw: [name="Eblana"]Do you truly wish for Tara to become a kingdom of death?
speaker: Eblana
content: Do you truly wish for Tara to become a kingdom of death?

raw: Loughshinny subconsciously turns her head away.
content: Loughshinny subconsciously turns her head away.

raw: The fierce purple flames still rage in the skeleton the hero dragged all the way here. Culann, now taken over by purple flames, briefly stands up before sinking back down to kneel.
content: The fierce purple flames still rage in the skeleton the hero dragged all the way here. Culann, now taken over by purple flames, briefly stands up before sinking back down to kneel.

raw: She cannot bear another look at him, so she turns her gaze back to her sister's eyes—and the hand she's been offered for so many years.
content: She cannot bear another look at him, so she turns her gaze back to her sister's eyes—and the hand she's been offered for so many years.

raw: It is unclear if it is her imagination or a side effect of the purple flames depriving everything they touch of vitality, but the hand before her seems so pale and bloodless compared to the one in her memories.
content: It is unclear if it is her imagination or a side effect of the purple flames depriving everything they touch of vitality, but the hand before her seems so pale and bloodless compared to the one in her memories.

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]We speak of a city and the lives of countless people, Eblana. You cannot sum this up as a matter as simple as 'fate'.
speaker: Loughshinny
content: We speak of a city and the lives of countless people, Eblana. You cannot sum this up as a matter as simple as 'fate'.

raw: [name="Eblana"]Are you finished? I believe we've spent enough time talking past each other.
speaker: Eblana
content: Are you finished? I believe we've spent enough time talking past each other.

speaker: Loughshinny
content: ...Eblana!

raw: [name="Eblana"]Oh, but feel free to continue. If you so desire, I shall wait here for as long as you need me to.
speaker: Eblana
content: Oh, but feel free to continue. If you so desire, I shall wait here for as long as you need me to.

raw: [name="Eblana"]But do try not to take too long. You can afford to wait, yet that may not be true for others.
speaker: Eblana
content: But do try not to take too long. You can afford to wait, yet that may not be true for others.

raw: [name="Loughshinny"](Breathes deeply) You're right. You can afford to wait, but that may not be true for others.
speaker: Loughshinny
content: (Breathes deeply) You're right. You can afford to wait, but that may not be true for others.

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]Alright. I'll dance your dance. Until one of us falls and can dance no more.
speaker: Loughshinny
content: Alright. I'll dance your dance. Until one of us falls and can dance no more.

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]But I will not follow your lead. Absolutely not.
speaker: Loughshinny
content: But I will not follow your lead. Absolutely not.

speaker: Eblana
content: As you please.

raw: [name="Eblana"]Though you seem to have misunderstood something, my dear Loughshinny.
speaker: Eblana
content: Though you seem to have misunderstood something, my dear Loughshinny.

raw: [name="Eblana"]The one who cannot afford to wait is standing before you now.
speaker: Eblana
content: The one who cannot afford to wait is standing before you now.
'Cannot afford to wait'?

raw: Loughshinny scrutinizes her sister's face as she suddenly realizes something entirely unrelated to their conversation.
content: Loughshinny scrutinizes her sister's face as she suddenly realizes something entirely unrelated to their conversation.

raw: The offered hand is indeed pale, and it is not just her imagination.
content: The offered hand is indeed pale, and it is not just her imagination.

raw: Purple flames seem to weave together into an omnipresent cloak, giving Eblana her beautiful yet terrifying appearance. Yet they also fail to conceal the malady which seems to consume her beneath her pale white skin.
content: Purple flames seem to weave together into an omnipresent cloak, giving Eblana her beautiful yet terrifying appearance. Yet they also fail to conceal the malady which seems to consume her beneath her pale white skin.

raw: She shouldn't be like this. She was never like this before.
content: She shouldn't be like this. She was never like this before.

speaker: Loughshinny
content: Eblana, are you...

speaker: Eblana
content: Hm?

speaker: Loughshinny
content: You...

speaker: Loughshinny
content: Are you... alright, Sister?

raw: A smile spreads across Eblana's face. The same old ice-cold smile is always found there.
content: A smile spreads across Eblana's face. The same old ice-cold smile is always found there.

raw: This time, it seems to bear some warmth, but this only highlights her conspicuous paleness.
content: This time, it seems to bear some warmth, but this only highlights her conspicuous paleness.

raw: [name="Eblana"]I appreciate your concern. Really, I do.
speaker: Eblana
content: I appreciate your concern. Really, I do.

raw: [name="Eblana"]After all those apathetic partings and painful reunions, to only now hear you asking if I'm well... It has truly been so long.
speaker: Eblana
content: After all those apathetic partings and painful reunions, to only now hear you asking if I'm well... It has truly been so long.

raw: [name="Eblana"]Incidentally, I really do want a dance with you.
speaker: Eblana
content: Incidentally, I really do want a dance with you.

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]...I will, once I find a way to heal you.
speaker: Loughshinny
content: ...I will, once I find a way to heal you.

raw: [name="Eblana"]Very well. Then I shall await you here.
speaker: Eblana
content: Very well. Then I shall await you here.

raw: Eblana strides towards the citadel, her footsteps so faint that they seem almost frail.
content: Eblana strides towards the citadel, her footsteps so faint that they seem almost frail.

speaker: Brigid
content: Phew...

speaker: Brigid
content: Hoo... Red dragon! Nemos!

raw: [name="Brigid"]There was no one at the gates when I got back! I thought something must've happened! What's going on in the square—
speaker: Brigid
content: There was no one at the gates when I got back! I thought something must've happened! What's going on in the square—

speaker: Brigid
content: Red dragon... what's that...?

raw: Loughshinny is holding a small box in her arms. The dim night lights seem to make it harder than usual to see.
content: Loughshinny is holding a small box in her arms. The dim night lights seem to make it harder than usual to see.

speaker: Loughshinny
content: I couldn't save Culann. I...

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]This was the only way for him to rest in peace. So he'd no longer have to suffer from the flames in the square.
speaker: Loughshinny
content: This was the only way for him to rest in peace. So he'd no longer have to suffer from the flames in the square.

raw: The nomad is silent for a long time, until she finds a stone on the ground.
content: The nomad is silent for a long time, until she finds a stone on the ground.

raw: She hurls it with all her strength towards the citadel.
content: She hurls it with all her strength towards the citadel.

raw: But the darkness of the night swallows it up, and it fails to even make a sound.
content: But the darkness of the night swallows it up, and it fails to even make a sound.

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]It's already past curfew. Nemos, Brigid, let's just—
speaker: Loughshinny
content: It's already past curfew. Nemos, Brigid, let's just—

speaker: Nemos
content: No...

speaker: Nemos
content: No.

raw: Nemos reaches out to the wooden box, as if trying to brush nonexistent dust off the lid.
content: Nemos reaches out to the wooden box, as if trying to brush nonexistent dust off the lid.

raw: She suddenly recalls being rejected by her own people a few days ago, and the superfluous words she heard then.
content: She suddenly recalls being rejected by her own people a few days ago, and the superfluous words she heard then.

raw: [name="Solemn Wakewoman"]The wakemen do not stand with the living, nor do we require their reverence. Until, of course, they are dead.
speaker: Solemn Wakewoman
content: The wakemen do not stand with the living, nor do we require their reverence. Until, of course, they are dead.

raw: [name="Solemn Wakewoman"]That is the tradition Dublinn should be honoring.
speaker: Solemn Wakewoman
content: That is the tradition Dublinn should be honoring.

raw: [name="Nemos"]Still, I'm grateful you were at least willing to give me this whistle... I'll be going now.
speaker: Nemos
content: Still, I'm grateful you were at least willing to give me this whistle... I'll be going now.

raw: [name="Solemn Wakewoman"]Wait, Nemos. You knew well that Samhain approaches and the wakemen would be lacking sacred instruments. Yet you still came.
speaker: Solemn Wakewoman
content: Wait, Nemos. You knew well that Samhain approaches and the wakemen would be lacking sacred instruments. Yet you still came.

raw: [name="Solemn Wakewoman"]Did the Dublinners force you to?
speaker: Solemn Wakewoman
content: Did the Dublinners force you to?

raw: [name="Nemos"]No, I came here of my own—
speaker: Nemos
content: No, I came here of my own—

raw: [name="Solemn Wakewoman"]Nemos, you haven't changed one bit.
speaker: Solemn Wakewoman
content: Nemos, you haven't changed one bit.

raw: [name="Solemn Wakewoman"]You wait, mediate, and reconcile... Are you also like this in Na Saoirsí? Do you also serve the Red Dragon like this?
speaker: Solemn Wakewoman
content: You wait, mediate, and reconcile... Are you also like this in Na Saoirsí? Do you also serve the Red Dragon like this?

raw: [name="Nemos"]I just... don't want to see a situation that could be improved deteriorate any further. Or people who could have cooperated fighting each other.
speaker: Nemos
content: I just... don't want to see a situation that could be improved deteriorate any further. Or people who could have cooperated fighting each other.

raw: [name="Solemn Wakewoman"]If conflict is inevitable, you will only ever sink deeper into the mire.
speaker: Solemn Wakewoman
content: If conflict is inevitable, you will only ever sink deeper into the mire.

raw: [name="Solemn Wakewoman"]The city has tainted you with its darkness, Nemos.
speaker: Solemn Wakewoman
content: The city has tainted you with its darkness, Nemos.

speaker: Nemos
content: So, The Leader—the Red Dragon—

raw: [name="Nemos"]Eblana will never give Na Saoirsí true life? Is that right, Loughshinny?
speaker: Nemos
content: Eblana will never give Na Saoirsí true life? Is that right, Loughshinny?

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]She said she couldn't. She... actually doesn't like to lie, unless there are other circumstances...
speaker: Loughshinny
content: She said she couldn't. She... actually doesn't like to lie, unless there are other circumstances...

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=30, ystrength=30, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[name="Nemos"]She's The Leader of Tara, the one and only Red Dragon, what could possibly be tying her hands?!
speaker: Nemos
content: She's The Leader of Tara, the one and only Red Dragon, what could possibly be tying her hands?!

speaker: Brigid
content: What's wrong, Nemos? You seem... different...

raw: [name="Nemos"]I get it. I finally get it, Your Highness Loughshinny.
speaker: Nemos
content: I get it. I finally get it, Your Highness Loughshinny.

raw: [name="Nemos"]It seems that that fire can in fact infect the living.
speaker: Nemos
content: It seems that that fire can in fact infect the living.

speaker: Loughshinny
content: Nemos?!

raw: [name="Nemos"]The people I once depended on turned out to be a swarm of selfish parasites.
speaker: Nemos
content: The people I once depended on turned out to be a swarm of selfish parasites.

raw: [name="Nemos"]The Leader I once believed in turned out to be an evil dragon who doesn't care if anyone else lives or dies.
speaker: Nemos
content: The Leader I once believed in turned out to be an evil dragon who doesn't care if anyone else lives or dies.

raw: [name="Nemos"]The people I once put my life on the line to protect... became the reason my closest friend died.
speaker: Nemos
content: The people I once put my life on the line to protect... became the reason my closest friend died.

raw: [name="Nemos"]I can't even imagine what they would have done to him if that wicked dragon hadn't lit him up with her flames.
speaker: Nemos
content: I can't even imagine what they would have done to him if that wicked dragon hadn't lit him up with her flames.

raw: [name="Nemos"]Culann was right to ask what we would do once Samhain is over. What should I do?
speaker: Nemos
content: Culann was right to ask what we would do once Samhain is over. What should I do?

raw: [name="Nemos"]Other than revenge, there's nothing left for me either.
speaker: Nemos
content: Other than revenge, there's nothing left for me either.

raw: As she utters these words, Loughshinny sees a flame ignite within the final Na Saoirsían left untainted by the purple fire.
content: As she utters these words, Loughshinny sees a flame ignite within the final Na Saoirsían left untainted by the purple fire.

raw: [name="Nemos"]Your Highness, will you regard me the same as the rest of the residents—a servant of Eblana?
speaker: Nemos
content: Your Highness, will you regard me the same as the rest of the residents—a servant of Eblana?

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]No. This deadly disease... It has ultimately infected even the last person in the city.
speaker: Loughshinny
content: No. This deadly disease... It has ultimately infected even the last person in the city.

raw: [name="Nemos"]If so, Your Highness, then I swear to you that I will aid you in this dance that's been forced on you. Until the very end...
speaker: Nemos
content: If so, Your Highness, then I swear to you that I will aid you in this dance that's been forced on you. Until the very end...

speaker: Nemos
content: Until the wicked dragon falls.

speaker: Loughshinny
content: ...I have heard your vow.

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]Now, I must leave the city for a while. Come with me, Nemos.
speaker: Loughshinny
content: Now, I must leave the city for a while. Come with me, Nemos.

speaker: Nemos
content: To the wakemen?

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]Mhm. I have no hope of curing the flame here, so I thought we should seek aid from anyone who might be able to help.
speaker: Loughshinny
content: Mhm. I have no hope of curing the flame here, so I thought we should seek aid from anyone who might be able to help.

raw: [name="Nemos"]No, I can't go with you. I have no right to be there anymore.
speaker: Nemos
content: No, I can't go with you. I have no right to be there anymore.

raw: [name="Nemos"]I'll stay in the city. As long as the Red Dragon doesn't realize what's going on and tear me apart... I'll try my best to keep the situation from deteriorating.
speaker: Nemos
content: I'll stay in the city. As long as the Red Dragon doesn't realize what's going on and tear me apart... I'll try my best to keep the situation from deteriorating.

raw: [name="Nemos"]Though, I'd appreciate it if you could return this whistle for me.
speaker: Nemos
content: Though, I'd appreciate it if you could return this whistle for me.

raw: [name="Nemos"]And... Culann too. Please give him a proper funeral.
speaker: Nemos
content: And... Culann too. Please give him a proper funeral.

raw: [name="Nemos"]A proper funeral requires eulogies from friends and family, so... I'll write one. Could you read it for me there?
speaker: Nemos
content: A proper funeral requires eulogies from friends and family, so... I'll write one. Could you read it for me there?

speaker: Loughshinny
content: ...Alright.

speaker: Nemos
content: Here. It's done.

raw: [name="Brigid"]I'll go with Reed. The Dark Woods aren't lettin' anyone in or out, but it should be smoother with us two.
speaker: Brigid
content: I'll go with Reed. The Dark Woods aren't lettin' anyone in or out, but it should be smoother with us two.

raw: [name="Nemos"]No, Brigid. You should stay too. I need your help.

content: No, Brigid. You should stay too. I need your help.

speaker: Brigid
content: Reed?

speaker: Loughshinny
content: I'll be fine by myself.

raw: [name="Brigid"]That works, but... Nemos, you're so different now.
speaker: Brigid
content: That works, but... Nemos, you're so different now.

raw: [name="Nemos"]...I guess this is what vengeance does to a person.
speaker: Nemos
content: ...I guess this is what vengeance does to a person.
